description: Find the fix page for a CLI error message. Paste the exact error line, a fragment of it, or the whole terminal output (for example "unexpected argument '--full-auto' found"). Returns matching fix pages with the exact error, tool, affected versions, the fix in one line and page URLs. With an empty query, lists every fix page.

query.description: Error text or a fragment of it

tool.description: Optional tool id or name to restrict the search, e.g. asc, codex, wrangler

name: search_fixes
title: Search fix pages by error text
